messages.subject: Executive Value Proposition | Emirates | International & Government Affairs, ESG and Strategic Partnerships
messages.body:
Dear Mr. Lofberg,

I am writing to share an executive value proposition aligned with Emirates' international and government affairs agenda.

I currently serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department, at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My mandate spans senior government and regulatory relations, ESG, corporate affairs, stakeholder strategy, strategic partnerships and executive advisory within a capital-intensive multinational operating environment.

My work sits at the point where executive priorities, regulation, external stakeholders and operating delivery meet. I coordinate complex matters across ministries, regulators, technical teams, operations and senior management, with a strong focus on institutional relationships, evidence, accountability and reputation-sensitive execution.

Rather than send a conventional CV alone, I have attached an Emirates-specific strategic value brief together with my three-page international executive CV. It outlines where I believe my experience could support Emirates or the wider Group across international and government affairs, external affairs, ESG and sustainability, strategic partnerships, stakeholder management or country-facing leadership.

I would value a confidential discussion if you see potential alignment.

Kind regards,

Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director | AGM Inc., Zijin Mining Group
Georgetown, Guyana
+592 608 4735

strategic_brief.title: Strategic Value Creation Proposition for Emirates Airline
strategic_brief.prepared_for_title: Senior Vice President, International and Government Affairs
strategic_brief.executive_summary: Emirates operates at the intersection of global aviation policy, market access, government relationships, sustainability expectations, infrastructure and international connectivity. My value proposition is to strengthen the institutional and execution layer around those priorities. As Liaison Director at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group, I lead country-facing government and regulatory relations, ESG and social responsibility coordination, corporate affairs, stakeholder strategy and executive advisory in a capital-intensive multinational environment. I would bring Emirates a practical combination of government-interface leadership, cross-functional coordination, ESG evidence discipline and executive issue management relevant to international and government affairs, market access, sustainability, strategic partnerships and country-facing execution.
strategic_brief.company_context: Emirates is one of the world's largest international airlines and a core component of Dubai's global connectivity model. Its international network depends on sustained engagement with governments, aviation authorities, regulators, airports, tourism bodies and industry institutions across many jurisdictions. The Group's ongoing fleet and network expansion, investment in operational efficiency and sustainability, and continued advocacy around market access increase the importance of disciplined institutional relationships and coordinated external execution. Emirates' official July 2024 senior appointments announcement confirmed Will Lofberg as Senior Vice President, International and Government Affairs, underscoring the strategic importance of the function to the airline's global operating model.

opportunities.title: International Government Stakeholder Architecture
opportunities.rationale: Emirates' network and growth ambitions create recurring interfaces with transport ministries, civil aviation authorities, airport operators, trade and tourism bodies, diplomatic stakeholders and other public institutions. A structured stakeholder architecture helps leadership maintain visibility of decision pathways, institutional expectations and emerging issues across priority markets.
opportunities.how_i_can_help: I would map priority stakeholders, institutional dependencies and engagement ownership, then establish concise executive briefs, relationship plans, commitment trackers and escalation routes. My current role applies the same discipline across multiple regulators and public bodies where external decisions directly affect operations.

opportunities.title: Country and Market Readiness
opportunities.rationale: International growth requires more than commercial demand. Regulatory expectations, public-sector priorities, stakeholder sensitivities, sustainability obligations and local institutional dynamics influence the speed and durability of market access and partnership outcomes.
opportunities.how_i_can_help: I would support country-readiness workstreams by integrating government relations, stakeholder mapping, ESG considerations, institutional intelligence and execution ownership into concise market briefs for leadership and cross-functional teams.

opportunities.title: ESG and Sustainability Evidence Governance
opportunities.rationale: Aviation faces sustained scrutiny around climate performance, operational efficiency, environmental commitments and credible reporting. Executive confidence depends on traceable evidence, accountable owners and disciplined stakeholder communication.
opportunities.how_i_can_help: I would support sustainability governance by linking commitments to operating evidence, management actions and external engagement. I have coordinated a carbon-accounting proof of concept using physical operating records and support stakeholder governance around a major solar and battery-storage platform.

opportunities.title: Strategic Partnerships and Institutional Alignment
opportunities.rationale: Emirates' role in trade, tourism and global connectivity creates opportunities for deeper collaboration with governments, investment agencies, destination partners, industry bodies and major corporate stakeholders. Strong institutional alignment helps convert relationships into measurable commercial and strategic outcomes.
opportunities.how_i_can_help: I would help structure partnership workstreams that connect business objectives with government priorities, institutional stakeholders and accountable delivery, using executive briefs, action ownership, milestone tracking and senior engagement planning.

opportunities.title: Executive Issues and Reputation Readiness
opportunities.rationale: International aviation regularly encounters policy changes, regulatory matters, stakeholder concerns and reputation-sensitive issues requiring fast coordination across legal, operations, communications, sustainability and senior management.
opportunities.how_i_can_help: I would establish concise issue briefs, stakeholder-risk registers, evidence trackers and escalation protocols. I routinely coordinate sensitive regulator-facing and cross-functional matters with emphasis on factual accuracy, accountability and closure.

days_0_30: Confirm priority markets and workstreams where government, stakeholder or ESG execution would create the strongest near-term value.
Map ministries, regulators, aviation authorities, institutional partners and internal owners against strategic objectives.
Review active commitments, external dependencies, stakeholder intelligence and executive escalation processes.
days_31_60: Select priority country or policy pilots based on strategic importance, stakeholder complexity and leadership sponsorship.
Build integrated engagement plans with clear objectives, evidence requirements, ownership and escalation thresholds.
Create an executive dashboard covering institutional dependencies, commitments, emerging issues and partnership opportunities.
days_61_90: Launch pilot engagement plans with concise executive briefing materials for priority government and institutional interactions.
Connect ESG and sustainability commitments to operating evidence, action owners and management review.
Establish a structured lessons process to identify repeatable practices across markets.
days_91_180: Scale effective practices into a common toolkit for government relations, country readiness and executive issue management.
Measure impact through decision-cycle time, issue closure, stakeholder outcomes, evidence quality and reduced execution friction.
Institutionalize a reporting cadence giving leadership earlier visibility of regulatory dependencies and strategic opportunities.

potential_impact: Earlier visibility of government and regulatory dependencies across priority markets.
Stronger country-level readiness for network, partnership and policy initiatives.
More consistent translation of sustainability commitments into operating evidence and executive reporting.
Higher-quality executive decisions through concise stakeholder intelligence and issue escalation.
A repeatable institutional framework connecting international affairs strategy with country-level execution.
background_relevance: Current Liaison Director at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group, with country-facing responsibility spanning government and regulatory relations, ESG, social responsibility, corporate affairs, stakeholder strategy and executive communications.
Leads senior institutional engagement across mining, environment, energy, aviation, labour, standards, taxation, trade, investment and social-performance matters.

Coordinates official visits, approvals, inspections, external commitments and sensitive issues across operations, HSE, environment, legal, finance, procurement, HR, security, aviation and technical teams.
Supports stakeholder governance around approximately 46-50 MWp of solar capacity and more than 80 MWh of battery storage.
Coordinated a 2026 carbon-accounting proof of concept linking physical operating data across fuel, electricity, explosives, material movement, production and refinery records.
Brings 12+ years across multinational mining, regulated financial services and commercial operations, supported by an MBA and international executive-development exposure.
